entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-10
entry.content:

  • Version 14 choose different extension that Version 13 #80221

    Next
  • Availability of Microsoft.Net.Compilers.Toolset on NuGet matching VS2026 Insiders #80213
